ideas.pitch: An AI-powered agriculture platform offering crop disease detection, yield prediction, and offline SMS alerts for farmers with low connectivity.
ideas.problem_statement: AgroTech (SDG 2, 12, 13, 15) - Turning raw agricultural data into working prototypes that address sustainable food production and climate resilience.
ideas.title: AgriConnect Offline SMS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on a proven winning project pattern by combining high-accuracy computer vision with low-bandwidth offline accessibility, addressing a massive real-world sustainability challenge.

ideas.pitch: Satellite monitoring system for tracking industrial land compliance and environmental degradation using geospatial datasets.
ideas.problem_statement: Urban Tech (SDG 6, 7, 9, 11) - Leveraging urban and environmental data to monitor sustainable industrial expansion and land usage.
ideas.title: GeoNex Industrial Land Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses unique geospatial data sources that stand out to judges, following the pattern of leveraging hard-to-get datasets for high environmental impact.

ideas.pitch: Power BI and Python-backed carbon footprint optimization platform for analyzing and minimizing emissions in supply chain logistics.
ideas.problem_statement: Urban Tech (SDG 6, 7, 9, 11) - Innovating around sustainable infrastructure, clean energy integration, and smart urban logistics.
ideas.title: LogiCarbon Logistics Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a recent enterprise hackathon winner by presenting complex supply chain data through interactive, decision-ready analytics dashboards.

ideas.pitch: A full-stack transparency tool connecting residents to local power generation data, linking municipal energy usage to specific coal and renewable sources.
ideas.problem_statement: Urban Tech (SDG 6, 7, 9, 11) - Providing transparent access to clean energy adoption metrics and resource consumption tracking.
ideas.title: PowerGrid Supply Trace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates complex federal and local open datasets into an intuitive consumer-facing application, aligning with proven developer weekend winning criteria.

ideas.pitch: A direct-to-consumer marketplace connecting local organic farmers with urban buyers to eliminate middlemen and reduce food waste.
ideas.problem_statement: AgroTech (SDG 2, 12, 13, 15) - Responsible consumption and production through localized agricultural supply chain optimization.
ideas.title: KisanBazar Organic Direct
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a validated hackathon-winning full-stack architecture with clear economic and social metrics that resonate strongly with judges.
